instruction:
Resolve Bitcoin block height 800000 using the supplied Blockstream block-height endpoint. Append the returned hash to https://blockstream.info/api/block/ and, from that block response, report id, height, timestamp, tx_count, size, weight, merkle_root, and previousblockhash.

Stopping condition: Stop after the resolved hash and all requested fields from its exact block record have been reported.

Constraints:
- Use the hash returned by the supplied block-height endpoint; do not search for a different block.
- Construct only the documented /api/block/{hash} follow-up URL.
- Preserve hashes and the Unix timestamp exactly as returned; do not convert or abbreviate them.
- Keep size and weight distinct and do not infer units not present in the response.
